guesses.reason: Broad bear-like head, thick neck, small deep-set brown eyes, erect thick triangular ears, dense double coat, and a plush curled tail over the back are classic American Akita traits, and the black-and-white pinto pattern is common in the breed.

breed.appearance: A large, sturdy spitz-type dog with a broad, bear-like black head, a thin white blaze running up the center of the forehead, and a slightly graying black muzzle with a big black nose and white whiskers. He has thick, upright triangular black ears, small almond-shaped warm brown eyes, a white chest and legs, and a black saddle patch on his back. His plush cream-white tail curls up high over his back, and his dense double coat looks slightly coarse.
breed.fun_fact: Akitas are famously loyal; the legendary Akita Hachikō waited for his owner at a Tokyo train station every day for nearly ten years!
